{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm the 'revenue' column is now numeric
print("Revenue dtype after parsing:", df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for any suspicious revenue values
suspicious_revenue = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of suspicious revenue rows:", suspicious_revenue.shape[0])

# Check if they are in the converted group
converted_suspicious = suspicious_revenue['converted'].sum()
print("Number of suspicious revenue rows with converted == 1:", converted_suspicious)

# Now, extract the subset of converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check for -1 in customer_age within converted customers
converted_with_missing_age = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] == -1]
print("Number of converted customers with missing age (-1):", converted_with_missing_age.shape[0])

# Compute mean age for converted customers, excluding -1 (as it's a sentinel)
mean_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
